items.question: Why can a regular tiling pattern cover a region without gaps?
items.expected_answer: The shapes fit edge-to-edge according to a repeating pattern.
reasoning_points: Check that the repeated arrangement leaves no uncovered spaces or overlaps.

items.question: How many sides does a quadrilateral have?
reasoning_points: The name 'quadrilateral' refers to a four-sided polygon.

items.question: A circle has radius 4 cm. Find its diameter.
How many square faces does a cube have?
reasoning_points: A cube has six congruent square faces.

items.question: A shape has four sides and four right angles. What familiar shape can it be?
items.expected_answer: A rectangle; if all four sides are equal, it is a square.
reasoning_points: Use both side and angle properties.

items.question: Why are icosahedron and dodecahedron named by face counts?
items.expected_answer: Their names describe the number of faces: icosahedron has 20, dodecahedron has 12.
reasoning_points: Count the faces of the solids/nets.
